_purpose: The specification of `mayReachProtect`, written once and verified by BOTH implementations: contracts/src/TinjauRiskTypes.sol and apps/server/src/risk/types.ts. Neither language generates this file; it is hand-written from tracker §0.7, so if either implementation drifts from the rules, its own test fails against this table.

_fields.independentSources: count of genuinely independent origins, syndications already collapsed
_fields.officialEvidencePassed: whether the bonded parse-agreement path passed

rows.name: rumour with everything else perfect
rows.why: §0.7 invariant 1: rumour-only is capped unconditionally, and no market or bonded argument can lift it.

rows.name: unknown class is never trusted
rows.why: Ordinal 0 means the value was never written. An unwritten class must not inherit trust.

rows.name: one news origin, confirmed
rows.why: §0.7 invariant 3: one news source alone never authorises the aggressive path, however many outlets reprinted it.

rows.name: two news origins, confirmed
rows.why: The two-independent-source bar plus fresh confirmation is exactly what §0.7 permits.

rows.name: two news origins, not confirmed
rows.why: The market looked and did not corroborate.

rows.name: two news origins, market unavailable
rows.why: 'Could not look' is not confirmation. Missing data must never CREATE a protection.

rows.name: two news origins, market stale
rows.why: A stale observation describes a different market.

rows.name: two news origins, confirmation never written
rows.why: Ordinal 0 fails closed like every other Unknown sentinel.

rows.name: official, bonded passed, confirmed
rows.why: The official path does not need two origins — the filing is the issuer speaking — but it still needs the market to corroborate.

rows.name: official, bonded passed, not confirmed
rows.why: An official filing is a strong reason to look, not a licence to act without looking.

rows.name: official, bonded passed, market unavailable
rows.why: Same rule; missing data cannot start a protection.

rows.name: official, bonded FAILED, confirmed
rows.why: The existing parse-agreement and bonded-publication requirements are a precondition, not a formality.

rows.name: official with zero independent sources still promotes
rows.why: The two-source rule governs NON-official evidence only. Requiring a filing to be corroborated by news would make the issuer's own disclosure the weakest evidence class.

rows.name: official with bonded passed but unknown confirmation
